name: Toggle
summary: Switch for a setting that works straight away, without saving.
use: Settings: notifications on, dark mode on.
avoid: Choices in a form you still have to submit: use Checkbox.
behaviour: Switches straight away. Show the result without an extra confirmation.
a11y: Native checkbox with role="switch". Screen readers announce on/off.
Status is not only color: the knob moves too.
content: The label names the setting, not the action: "Notifications", not "Turn on notifications".
do: In settings lists, put the label on the left and the toggle on the right, or the other way round, but always the same.
dont: A toggle that only works after "Save".
